headline: TBR @ NYY matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TBR 4.52 at NYY 4.04, with a projected total of 8.55. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TBR: TBR moved +0.66 runs while NYY moved -0.34, changing the projected margin by +1.00 runs. The projected total climbed +0.32, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +16.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Nick Martinez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Junior Caminero, Yandy Díaz, Nick Fortes, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Austin Wells, Ryan McMahon because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
